title: Hyperbolic geometry — Question 10.8
exact_target: Can an essential lamination be isotoped within the fixed hyperbolic metric so every leaf has Gaussian curvature at least minus two?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300046 (AMR-102-0046). CC BY 4.0.
